word: hit the nail on the head
pronunciationKo: 힛 더 네일 온 더 헷
exampleEn: You really hit the nail on the head with your analysis of the problem.
exampleKo: 당신이 문제에 대한 분석을 하면서 정말 정확히 맞았습니다.
gameExamples: When she explained the reasons for the delay, she truly hit the nail on the head.
His suggestion to streamline the process really hit the nail on the head.
During the meeting, I think you hit the nail on the head when you addressed the main issue.
